user_inputs.cohort_description: Prior heart failure diagnosis, end-stage renal disease

conversation_history.content: Which single clinical event should define the index date for this cohort: the first diagnosis of heart failure, the first diagnosis of end-stage renal disease, a hospitalization for heart failure, the first co-occurrence (both diagnoses on same day), or something else? Please specify whether you mean the 'first' occurrence or 'any' occurrence.
Are there any age or sex restrictions for this cohort? For example, limit to adults (age ≥18), older adults (age ≥65), or include all ages; and include all sexes or restrict to male or female only?
Do you require a minimum continuous observation (enrollment) period before the index date? For example: 365 days continuous observation prior to index, 180 days, or no prior observation requirement?

What should the observation/follow-up window after the index date be? Options: (A) Follow-up until end of continuous observation or death (no fixed duration), (B) Fixed duration (please specify duration, e.g., 30 days, 90 days, 1 year), or (C) Fixed duration but censor at death/end of enrollment. If you don't know, reply 'standard' to use option A.

Are there any exclusion criteria that should disqualify someone from the cohort? For example: prior kidney transplant at any time, history of heart transplant, prior or ongoing dialysis before the index date, active metastatic cancer, pregnancy at the index date, or other conditions/treatments. If there are no exclusions, reply 'none'.
✅ **Clarification complete!** I have all the information needed to define your cohort.

cohort_definition.index_event: First date on which both a diagnosis of heart failure and a diagnosis of end-stage renal disease are recorded on the same day (first co-occurrence).
inclusion_criteria: History of heart failure any time before the index date (prior diagnosis of heart failure at any time before the index event).
Diagnosis of end-stage renal disease on the index date as part of the co-occurrence.
Adults aged 18 years or older at the index date (age >= 18).
cohort_definition.observation_window: Follow-up from index until end of continuous observation (end of enrollment) or death; no fixed follow-up duration.
cohort_definition.prior_observation: No prior observation or continuous enrollment requirement before index.
cohort_definition.cohort_exit: Exit cohort at end of continuous observation (end of enrollment) or at death.
